subject: HyperMart renewal: hybrid reserved capacity + reranker onboarding
messages:
From: Amira Hassan <amira@hypermart.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@hypermart.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: HyperMart renewal & model mix update

Hi Vivek,

We're up for renewal in September and wanted to flag two changes on our side that will impact capacity:

- We're piloting a higher-accuracy reranker (Lumen-34B reranker) for search relevance. Expect ~15% of traffic to be reranker calls with higher compute per request.
- We're moving a set of catalog enrichment pipelines to a 128k-context model for batch re-ranking and extraction (longer context, larger activation memory).

High-level ask: can Redwood help scope additional reserved capacity (hybrid pool) for the renewal so we don't see throttling during peak traffic? We'd like a rough estimate of GPU counts / pool split and any throughput SLA options.

Also, procurement will want pricing for 12 vs 24 month terms and any commitment discounts. Looping procurement (procurement@hypermart.com) on the thread.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

— Amira
Platform Lead, HyperMart
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Amira Hassan <amira@hypermart.com>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.inference>, aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HyperMart renewal & model mix update

Amira — thanks for the heads up. This is precisely the sort of model-mix change that drives reserved-pool planning, so good to get it early.

Two quick asks so we size correctly:
- Typical per-minute request rate and peak 5-minute spike factor for your search and enrichment pipelines (rough numbers ok).
- Target p95 latency SLO for both the inference (online search) and the batch extraction job (can be higher latency).

Connor (SE) — can you draft a first-pass capacity table (GPU counts + pool split) based on Amira's note? A simple H100 vs A100 mix and recommended throughput SLA options would be ideal.

I'll schedule a 30m sync next week with HyperMart and procurement to walk pricing/term tradeoffs.

— Vivek
Head, Platform Sales — Redwood Inference
From: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.inference>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Amira Hassan <amira@hypermart.com>
Cc: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.inference>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HyperMart renewal & model mix update — capacity sketch (attachment)

Amira / Vivek — attached is a first-pass capacity_table.xlsx (summary below). Assumptions are conservative; we can right-size after a traffic sample or a 1-week canary.

Summary proposal (initial):
- Hybrid reserved pool: 6x H100 + 8x A100 (region: us-west-2), split by routing policy.
- Reranker traffic routed to H100s (estimated 15% of queries, 2.5x compute cost per call).
- Long-context batch jobs scheduled on A100s with dedicated slots; we recommend 4 A100s pinned for nightly jobs to avoid interfering with online throughput.
- Throughput guarantee options:
  * Standard: 1500 reqs/min (p95 <= 400ms)
  * Premium: 2500 reqs/min (p95 <= 300ms) + 99.9% uptime SLA for the dedicated pool

Cost delta: Premium SLA + H100-heavy mix adds ~28% to current committed monthly spend. 24-month commit reduces that delta by ~12%.

Attachments: capacity_table.xlsx (see tab: "traffic_to_gpus")

Happy to walk the workbook in a call.

— Connor
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: procurement@hypermart.com
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, connor_obrien <connor@redwood.inference>
Cc: Amira Hassan <amira@hypermart.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HyperMart renewal & model mix update — SOW/pricing request

Vivek / Connor — procurement here. Please send a formal SOW and pricing for both 12- and 24-month terms, including:
- Itemized GPU counts and pool definitions
- Throughput SLA options and credits for missed SLAs
- Onboarding timeline and canary window (we'll need at least 2 weeks to coordinate infra changes)
- Security questionnaire answers (SOC 2 controls, KMS integration) — attachable doc preferred.

Also include any options for a phased roll (start with 4 H100 / 6 A100, then expand at month 3). We'll evaluate 24-month for discount.

— HyperMart Procurement
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: procurement@hypermart.com, Amira Hassan <amira@hypermart.com>, connor_obrien <connor@redwood.inference>
Cc: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.inference>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HyperMart renewal — draft SOW and term options (attachments)

Team — attached: SOW_HyperMart_v2.pdf (formal SOW), security-questionnaire-answers.docx, and the updated capacity_table.xlsx (same workbook, pricing tab updated). Highlights:

- Proposed baseline (12mo): 6x H100 + 8x A100 reserved, premium throughput (2500 reqs/min) for online search, 4 A100 pinned for nightly long-context jobs.
- Reranker add-on priced as a per-1000-call unit (reflects higher inference cost); estimate 15% of queries -> per-month unit charge included.
- 24mo term: 14% discount on committed spend, includes one pro-rated onboarding credit (applied to first invoice) and a 30% discounted rate for the reranker add-on for months 13–24.
- SLA: 99.9% uptime for the dedicated pool; credits tiered (5% credit for a single monthly violation up to 25% for repeated misses).
- Rollout: 2-week canary in us-west-2 with traffic-shift steps 10/30/60/100% over 72 hours, full rollback policy to the existing model variants.
- DocuSign link included for the 24mo SOW if you decide to proceed: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123

Attachments referenced: SOW_HyperMart_v2.pdf, security-questionnaire-answers.docx, capacity_table.xlsx

Let us know if procurement needs line items separated by tax jurisdiction; we can provide a PO-ready invoice.

— Vivek
From: Amira Hassan <amira@hypermart.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@hypermart.com, connor_obrien <connor@redwood.inference>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.inference>

Vivek / team — thanks for the clear SOW and pricing. Procurement and engineering reviewed and we're ready to move forward on the 24-month commitment with the Premium throughput SLA and the reranker add-on. A few minor notes:

- We'll sign the 24mo SOW via DocuSign this afternoon.
- Please schedule the 2-week canary to start the week of 2027-09-12 (headroom for our internal release calendar).
- Can you confirm the on-call rotation for the canary window and the escalation path (SE -> Technical Account Manager -> Infra ops)?
